# Seeking Refuge in the Shepherd's Care

## Scripture

"The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul." - Psalm 23:1-3 (NIV)

## Reflection

As we navigate life's challenges, it's easy to feel overwhelmed and uncertain. We may struggle to find peace and rest in a world that seems to be constantly in flux. But Psalm 23 reminds us that God is our Shepherd, and He cares for us deeply. He provides for our needs, guides us through difficult times, and rejuvenates our spirits. This is not just a theoretical concept, but a personal reality that we can experience in our daily lives. When we trust in God's goodness and sovereignty, we can find rest and peace, even in the midst of chaos. We can learn to surrender our worries and fears to Him, knowing that He is working all things for our good.

## Prayer

We confess, Lord, that we often feel lost and alone. We seek refuge in Your loving care and guidance. Help us to trust in Your goodness and sovereignty, and to find rest in Your presence.

## One-Line Application

We can find peace and rest by trusting in God's loving care and guidance.
